caption:
Sure your worship pleases God? He can't stand worship that stops at the door. (Amos 5:21 devotional)

God refuses worship walled off from life; real worship spills into the ordinary. He meets you in the ordinary places too.

📌 Save this for your quiet time
💬 Does my worship stay in the sanctuary — and never reach how I live?
